lines.text: Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, entered the house of the LORD, and sent Eliakim, Shebna, and the priests to Isaiah.
Hezekiah's message said children had come to the point of birth, and asked Isaiah to lift up a prayer for the remnant.
Isaiah said the LORD would put a spirit in the king of Assyria, who would hear a rumor and return home, and the Rabshakeh found him fighting against Gath.
Sennacherib, warned that Tirhakah king of Cush was coming, sent a letter, and Hezekiah read it and burned it on the altar.

wrong_details.true: spread it out before the LORD

lines.text: Hezekiah prayed that the LORD would save them from Sennacherib so all the kingdoms of the earth would know He alone is God.
